concept.zh: 同一条走廊 · 连续分段 · 减轻最重任务
concept.en: One corridor · Contiguous work zones · Minimize the heaviest load

brief.zh: loads 从左到右给出走廊每段的维修工时，工时为非负整数。把走廊切成刚好 crews 个连续区域，每个区域至少一段，所有段恰好被一组负责。每组工时等于区域内工时之和。求所有分法中，最重一组工时能有多小。crews 为正数，段数不足时返回 -1。
brief.en: loads lists nonnegative repair times from left to right. Split the corridor into exactly crews contiguous zones, with each zone containing at least one segment and each segment assigned once. A crew's load is the sum in its zone. Find the smallest possible load of the busiest crew. crews is positive. Return -1 if there are too few segments.
